UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, APRIL 4, 2024
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Naiomi Rainey, President  Gloria Cordero, Commissioner
Gina Maguire, Vice President  Robert Shannon, Commissioner
Kevin Scott, Secretary

Christopher J. Garner, General Manager  Richard Anthony, Principal Deputy City Attorney

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-52805  Recommendation to approve March 21, 2024 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-52807  Recommendation to adopt Specifications UD-24-156 and authorize the General
  Manager to execute contracts with Mitra Automation Technologies, Inc., and Mako
  Automation, Inc. to provide on-call professional services for the Supervisory Control
  and Data Acquisition (SCADA) and Radio Communication Network in an aggregate
  amount not to exceed $2,000,000 for a term of three years.

  Suggested Action:  Approved recommendation.

3.  24-52808  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute a Gas Services
  Agreement with Shell Energy North America (US), L.P., (SENA) for nomination,
  scheduling, and other tasks associated with natural gas delivery to the Long Beach
  Utilities Department natural gas pipeline system in the amount of $390,000 for a
  term of five years.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-52809  Recommendation to adopt Resolution UT-1512 authorizing the issuance of Senior
  Water Revenue Bonds (Series 2024 Bonds) and all related documents in an
  aggregate principal amount not to exceed $98 million, secured and solely payable
  from Water Fund revenues.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Utilities Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.
